# KromiumGpuMode

```kotlin
enum class KromiumGpuMode
```

- **Module:** `kromium-api`
- **Package:** `org.daviante.kromium.api.config`
- **Category:** Configuration
- **Since Version:** v1.0.0.150-b11

## Description

Controls GPU hardware acceleration and graphics rendering strategy. Determines how the Chromium engine interacts with host GPU drivers, which is critical for VM environments, CI pipelines, and machines with unstable or overclocked graphics hardware.

### When to Use

Set via KromiumHardwareConfig when running in virtual machines, Docker containers, or CI environments where GPU drivers may not be available. Use SOFTWARE for bulletproof CPU rendering, or ANGLE_WARP on Windows to avoid D3D device removal errors.

## States & Variants

| Variant | Declaration | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`HARDWARE`** | `HARDWARE` | Full hardware acceleration using native OS graphics APIs (DirectX/Direct3D on Windows, Metal on macOS, Vulkan/OpenGL on Linux). |
| **`SOFTWARE`** | `SOFTWARE` | Pure software rendering (CPU-based). Forces --disable-gpu, --use-gl=angle, and --use-angle=swiftshader. Completely eliminates any direct interaction with GPU drivers or hardware Direct3D devices. Recommended as a bulletproof fallback when running in virtual machines or on machines with unstable/overclocked graphics drivers. |
| **`COMPOSITING_DISABLED`** | `COMPOSITING_DISABLED` | Hardware-accelerated GPU rasterization with CPU compositing. Applies --disable-gpu-compositing. |
| **`ANGLE_WARP`** | `ANGLE_WARP` | Direct3D 11 WARP (Windows Advanced Rasterization Platform). Uses Microsoft's high-speed software Direct3D rasterizer. Bypasses vendor hardware drivers and avoids physical GPU device reset/removal errors (0x887a0005) while maintaining DirectX pipeline compatibility on Windows. |

## Code Examples

### Compose Multiplatform (kotlin)

```kotlin
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumConfig
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumGpuMode

val config = KromiumConfig.builder()
    .hardwareConfig { hw ->
        hw.gpuMode(KromiumGpuMode.SOFTWARE) // CPU-only rendering for CI
    }
    .build()
```

### Pure Java (java)

```java
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumConfig;
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumGpuMode;

KromiumConfig config = KromiumConfig.builder()
    .hardwareConfig(hw -> hw.gpuMode(KromiumGpuMode.ANGLE_WARP))
    .build();
```


---

# KromiumProcessModel

```kotlin
enum class KromiumProcessModel
```

- **Module:** `kromium-api`
- **Package:** `org.daviante.kromium.api.config`
- **Category:** Configuration
- **Since Version:** v1.0.0.150-b11

## Description

Defines the process isolation model used by Kromium and Chromium Embedded Framework. Controls whether the browser engine runs in-process within the host JVM, in a dedicated multi-process architecture via jcef_helper subprocesses, or as an external RPC server daemon.

### When to Use

Configure via KromiumConfig.builder().browserConfig { b -> b.processModel(...) }. Use AUTO (default) for desktop UI applications. Use IN_PROCESS when explicit single-process control is needed. Avoid OUT_OF_PROCESS for standard desktop apps as it requires custom CefNativeRenderHandler.

## States & Variants

| Variant | Declaration | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`AUTO`** | `AUTO` | Automatically chooses the best process model for the platform. Uses multi-process Chromium architecture where the browser host runs embedded in the host JVM while GPU acceleration, WebGL rasterization, and web renderers run in dedicated jcef_helper subprocesses with their own OS Process IDs (PIDs) via --browser-subprocess-path. Provides 100% compatibility with Compose Desktop (SwingPanel), Swing, JavaFX, and SWT in both Windowed and Off-Screen Rendering (OSR) modes. |
| **`OUT_OF_PROCESS`** | `OUT_OF_PROCESS` | Executes the Chromium browser engine in an external RPC server daemon (cef_server). In JetBrains JCEF, cef_server RPC mode requires a custom CefNativeRenderHandler (shared memory rasterization) and does not support standard Windowed (CefRendering.DEFAULT) or standard OSR rendering. Use AUTO or IN_PROCESS for desktop UI applications. |
| **`IN_PROCESS`** | `IN_PROCESS` | Executes the Chromium browser engine directly inside the host JVM process. When running in this mode, Kromium applies defensive GPU flags (such as --disable-direct-composition and --disable-gpu-watchdog on Windows) to prevent swapchain hijacking and Direct3D collisions with the host UI toolkit. |

## Code Examples

### Compose Multiplatform (kotlin)

```kotlin
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumConfig
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumProcessModel

val config = KromiumConfig.builder()
    .browserConfig { b ->
        b.processModel(KromiumProcessModel.AUTO)
    }
    .build()
```

### Pure Java (java)

```java
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumConfig;
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumProcessModel;

KromiumConfig config = KromiumConfig.builder()
    .browserConfig(b -> b.processModel(KromiumProcessModel.IN_PROCESS))
    .build();
```


---

# KromiumLogSeverity

```kotlin
enum class KromiumLogSeverity
```

- **Module:** `kromium-api`
- **Package:** `org.daviante.kromium.api.config`
- **Category:** Configuration
- **Since Version:** v1.0.0.150-b11

## Description

Log severity levels for the Chromium engine. Controls the verbosity of native CEF log output written to the Kromium log file.

### When to Use

Set via KromiumLoggingConfig when building KromiumConfig to control native log verbosity. Use DISABLE in production to suppress all native logging, or VERBOSE during debugging to capture full Chromium internals.

## States & Variants

| Variant | Declaration | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`DEFAULT`** | `DEFAULT` | Default Chromium log severity. Equivalent to INFO in most configurations. |
| **`VERBOSE`** | `VERBOSE` | Most verbose logging level. Captures all internal Chromium diagnostic output. |
| **`INFO`** | `INFO` | Informational messages about normal engine operation. |
| **`WARNING`** | `WARNING` | Warnings about potential issues that do not prevent operation. |
| **`ERROR`** | `ERROR` | Error conditions that may affect engine functionality. |
| **`FATAL`** | `FATAL` | Fatal errors that cause immediate engine termination. |
| **`DISABLE`** | `DISABLE` | Disables all native Chromium log output. Recommended for production deployments. |

## Code Examples

### Compose Multiplatform (kotlin)

```kotlin
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumConfig
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumLogSeverity

val config = KromiumConfig.builder()
    .loggingConfig { log ->
        log.severity(KromiumLogSeverity.DISABLE)
    }
    .build()
```

### Pure Java (java)

```java
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumConfig;
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumLogSeverity;

KromiumConfig config = KromiumConfig.builder()
    .loggingConfig(log -> log.severity(KromiumLogSeverity.WARNING))
    .build();
```

# KromiumContextMenuParams

```kotlin
data class KromiumContextMenuParams(
    val x: Int,
    val y: Int,
    val linkUrl: String? = null,
    val unfilteredLinkUrl: String? = null,
    val sourceUrl: String? = null,
    val hasImage: Boolean = false,
    val pageUrl: String? = null,
    val frameUrl: String? = null,
    val selectionText: String? = null,
    val misspelledWord: String? = null,
    val isEditable: Boolean = false,
    val isSpellCheckEnabled: Boolean = false
)
```

- **Module:** `kromium-api`
- **Package:** `org.daviante.kromium.api.ui`
- **Since Version:** v1.0.0.150-b11

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`x`** | `Int` | Horizontal coordinate relative to the browser viewport. |
| **`y`** | `Int` | Vertical coordinate relative to the browser viewport. |
| **`linkUrl`** | `String?` | The target URL if right-click occurred on a hyperlink. |
| **`unfilteredLinkUrl`** | `String?` | The unfiltered target URL if on a hyperlink. |
| **`sourceUrl`** | `String?` | The source URL if right-click occurred on media. |
| **`hasImage`** | `Boolean` | True if the clicked element has image contents. |
| **`pageUrl`** | `String?` | URL of the top-level page. |
| **`frameUrl`** | `String?` | URL of the specific subframe. |
| **`selectionText`** | `String?` | Any text currently highlighted/selected. |
| **`misspelledWord`** | `String?` | The misspelled word under cursor if spellcheck is active. |
| **`isEditable`** | `Boolean` | True if triggered inside an editable field. |

# KromiumSecurity

```kotlin

```

- **Since Version:** v1.0.0.150-b11

## Properties

| **`hostLockSubresources`** | `Boolean` | When true, host lock also restricts subresource network requests (scripts, xhr, fetch). |
| **`hostLockSubframes`** | `Boolean` | When true, host lock also restricts navigations in subframes (iframes). Defaults to false, allowing embedded verification widgets to navigate within iframes without violating host locking. |

# KromiumAssetFilter

```kotlin
data class KromiumAssetFilter(
    val blockedExtensions: Set<String> = emptySet(),
    val blockedUrlPatterns: Set<String> = emptySet(),
    val blockedResourceTypes: Set<KromiumResourceType> = emptySet(),
    val blockFilter: ((request: KromiumWebResourceRequest) -> Boolean)? = null,
    val allowedExtensions: Set<String> = emptySet(),
    val allowedUrlPatterns: Set<String> = emptySet(),
    val allowedResourceTypes: Set<KromiumResourceType> = emptySet(),
    val allowFilter: ((request: KromiumWebResourceRequest) -> Boolean)? = null,
    val allowMainFrame: Boolean = true,
    val mode: AssetFilterMode = AssetFilterMode.BLOCKLIST
)
```

- **Module:** `kromium-api`
- **Package:** `org.daviante.kromium.api.network`
- **Since Version:** v1.0.0.150-b11

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`blockedExtensions`** | `Set<String>` | File extensions to block. |
| **`blockedUrlPatterns`** | `Set<String>` | Substrings or URL patterns to block. |
| **`blockedResourceTypes`** | `Set<KromiumResourceType>` | Resource types to block. |
| **`blockFilter`** | `((request: KromiumWebResourceRequest) -> Boolean)?` | Custom functional predicate to determine if a request should be blocked. |
| **`allowedExtensions`** | `Set<String>` | File extensions to explicitly allow/whitelist. |
| **`allowedUrlPatterns`** | `Set<String>` | Substrings or URL patterns to explicitly allow. |
| **`allowedResourceTypes`** | `Set<KromiumResourceType>` | Resource types to explicitly allow. |
| **`allowFilter`** | `((request: KromiumWebResourceRequest) -> Boolean)?` | Custom functional predicate to determine if a request should be allowed. |
| **`allowMainFrame`** | `Boolean` | Whether to exempt the top-level main frame navigation from filtering. |
| **`mode`** | `AssetFilterMode` | Operating mode (BLOCKLIST or ALLOWLIST). |
| **`isEnabled`** | `Boolean` | Whether any filtering rules or allowlist mode are active. |

## Methods

### `shouldBlock()`

```kotlin
fun shouldBlock(request: KromiumWebResourceRequest): Boolean
```

Determines whether a given request should be blocked based on configured filter rules and mode.

```kotlin
data class KromiumWebResourceRequest(
```

# KromiumProxy

```kotlin
sealed class KromiumProxy
```

- **Module:** `kromium-api`
- **Package:** `org.daviante.kromium.api.proxy`
- **Category:** Network & Security
- **Since Version:** v1.0.0.150-b11

## Description

Defines the proxy strategy for the Kromium browser engine and client sessions. Supports Operating System Default, Direct bypass, WPAD Auto-Discovery, PAC script URLs, HTTP/HTTPS secure tunnels, SOCKS5 (with remote DNS resolution), and Multi-Protocol routing.

### When to Use

Configure in KromiumBrowserConfig, KromiumClientConfig, or dynamically at runtime via client.updateProxy(proxy) or browser.proxyManager.updateProxy(proxy).

## States & Variants

| Variant | Declaration | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`KromiumProxy.System`** | `data object System : KromiumProxy()` | Uses operating system default proxy configuration. |
| **`KromiumProxy.Direct`** | `data object Direct : KromiumProxy()` | Bypasses all proxies and connects directly to destination hosts. |
| **`KromiumProxy.AutoDetect`** | `data object AutoDetect : KromiumProxy()` | Automatically discovers proxy settings using Web Proxy Auto-Discovery (WPAD) via DHCP/DNS queries. |
| **`KromiumProxy.Pac`** | `data class Pac(val pacUrl: String) : KromiumProxy()` | Connects using a Proxy Auto-Configuration (PAC) script URL (e.g. http://pac.corp.internal/wpad.dat). |
| **`KromiumProxy.Http`** | `data class Http @JvmOverloads constructor(val host: String, val port: Int, val username: String? = null, val password: String? = null, val isSecure: Boolean = false, val bypassList: List<String> = emptyList()) : KromiumProxy()` | Connects via an HTTP or HTTPS forward proxy with optional credentials and bypass list. |
| **`KromiumProxy.Socks5`** | `data class Socks5 @JvmOverloads constructor(val host: String, val port: Int, val username: String? = null, val password: String? = null, val remoteDns: Boolean = true, val bypassList: List<String> = emptyList()) : KromiumProxy()` | Connects via a SOCKS5 (or SOCKS4) proxy with remote DNS resolution to prevent DNS leaks. |
| **`KromiumProxy.MultiProtocol`** | `data class MultiProtocol @JvmOverloads constructor(val http: String? = null, val https: String? = null, val ftp: String? = null, val socks: String? = null, val bypassList: List<String> = emptyList()) : KromiumProxy()` | Connects using separate, dedicated proxies for different network protocols (HTTP vs HTTPS vs SOCKS). |

## Methods

### `toCommandLineArgs()`

```kotlin
abstract fun toCommandLineArgs(): List<String>
```

Generates Chromium command-line switches (e.g. --proxy-server, --proxy-bypass-list) for process initialization.

- **Returns:** `List<String>`

### `toPreferenceMap()`

```kotlin
abstract fun toPreferenceMap(): Map<String, Any>
```

Generates the CEF preference dictionary required for dynamic runtime proxy reconfiguration.

- **Returns:** `Map<String, Any>`

### `validate()`

```kotlin
open fun validate()
```

Validates proxy parameters and throws KromiumException.InvalidConfig if blank or out of range.

- **Returns:** `Unit`
- **Throws:** `KromiumException.InvalidConfig`

### `getCredentials()`

```kotlin
open fun getCredentials(host: String?, port: Int? = null): Pair<String, String>?
```

Returns authentication credentials (username to password) configured for this proxy if the requested target matches.

- **Returns:** `Pair<String, String>?`

### `system()`

```kotlin
@JvmStatic fun system(): KromiumProxy
```

Factory method returning the System singleton proxy.

- **Returns:** `KromiumProxy`

### `direct()`

```kotlin
@JvmStatic fun direct(): KromiumProxy
```

Factory method returning the Direct singleton proxy.

- **Returns:** `KromiumProxy`

### `autoDetect()`

```kotlin
@JvmStatic fun autoDetect(): KromiumProxy
```

Factory method returning the AutoDetect WPAD singleton proxy.

- **Returns:** `KromiumProxy`

### `pac()`

```kotlin
@JvmStatic fun pac(pacUrl: String): KromiumProxy
```

Factory method creating a PAC script proxy.

- **Returns:** `KromiumProxy`

### `http()`

```kotlin
@JvmStatic @JvmOverloads fun http(host: String, port: Int, username: String? = null, password: String? = null, isSecure: Boolean = false, bypassList: List<String> = emptyList()): KromiumProxy
```

Factory method creating an authenticated or unauthenticated HTTP forward proxy.

- **Returns:** `KromiumProxy`

### `https()`

```kotlin
@JvmStatic @JvmOverloads fun https(host: String, port: Int, username: String? = null, password: String? = null, bypassList: List<String> = emptyList()): KromiumProxy
```

Factory method creating an authenticated secure HTTPS tunnel forward proxy.

- **Returns:** `KromiumProxy`

### `socks5()`

```kotlin
@JvmStatic @JvmOverloads fun socks5(host: String, port: Int, username: String? = null, password: String? = null, remoteDns: Boolean = true, bypassList: List<String> = emptyList()): KromiumProxy
```

Factory method creating a SOCKS5 proxy with remote DNS leak prevention.

- **Returns:** `KromiumProxy`

### `multiProtocol()`

```kotlin
@JvmStatic @JvmOverloads fun multiProtocol(http: String? = null, https: String? = null, ftp: String? = null, socks: String? = null, bypassList: List<String> = emptyList()): KromiumProxy
```

Factory method creating a MultiProtocol proxy router.

- **Returns:** `KromiumProxy`

## Exceptions

| Exception | When Thrown |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`KromiumException.InvalidConfig`** |  |

## Code Examples

### Compose Multiplatform (kotlin)

```kotlin
import org.daviante.kromium.api.proxy.KromiumProxy
import org.daviante.kromium.api.core.KromiumBrowser

fun applyProxy(browser: KromiumBrowser) {
    val proxy = KromiumProxy.http("127.0.0.1", 8080)
    browser.proxyManager.updateProxy(proxy)
}
```

### Pure Java (java)

```java
import org.daviante.kromium.api.proxy.KromiumProxy;
import org.daviante.kromium.api.core.KromiumBrowser;

public class ProxySetup {
    public static void configure(KromiumBrowser browser) {
        KromiumProxy proxy = KromiumProxy.socks5("127.0.0.1", 1080);
        browser.getProxyManager().updateProxy(proxy);
    }
}
```

# KromiumProxyManager

```kotlin
interface KromiumProxyManager
```

- **Module:** `kromium-api`
- **Package:** `org.daviante.kromium.api.proxy`
- **Category:** Network & Security
- **Since Version:** v1.0.0.150-b11

## Description

Facade for managing the proxy settings of the browser at runtime without restarting the browser engine or recreating the browser instance.

### When to Use

Access via browser.proxyManager to dynamically update proxy routing for an active browser instance.

## Methods

### `updateProxy()`

```kotlin
fun updateProxy(proxy: KromiumProxy): Boolean
```

Dynamically updates the proxy for this browser session.

- **Returns:** `Boolean`

## Code Examples

### Compose Multiplatform (kotlin)

```kotlin
import org.daviante.kromium.api.core.KromiumBrowser
import org.daviante.kromium.api.proxy.KromiumProxy

fun switchProxy(browser: KromiumBrowser, proxyHost: String, proxyPort: Int) {
    val proxy = KromiumProxy.http(proxyHost, proxyPort)
    val success = browser.proxyManager.updateProxy(proxy)
    println("Proxy switch success: $success")
}
```

### Pure Java (java)

```java
import org.daviante.kromium.api.core.KromiumBrowser;
import org.daviante.kromium.api.proxy.KromiumProxy;

public class ProxySwitcher {
    public static void setDirect(KromiumBrowser browser) {
        browser.getProxyManager().updateProxy(KromiumProxy.direct());
    }
}
```

# KromiumCookie

```kotlin
data class KromiumCookie(val name: String, val value: String, val domain: String?, val path: String, val isSecure: Boolean, val isHttpOnly: Boolean, val hasExpires: Boolean, val expires: Date?)
```

- **Module:** `kromium-api`
- **Package:** `org.daviante.kromium.api.cookie`
- **Category:** Storage & Cookies
- **Since Version:** v1.0.0.150-b11

## Description

Represents a single HTTP cookie in the Kromium engine, capturing name, value, domain, path, security flags (isSecure, isHttpOnly), and expiration date.

### When to Use

Used with KromiumCookieManager to inspect, set, or delete individual HTTP cookies across browser sessions.

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`name`** | `String` | The cookie name identifier. |
| **`value`** | `String` | The cookie value string. |
| **`domain`** | `String?` | The domain scope of the cookie (e.g. ".example.com"), or null for origin-only. |
| **`path`** | `String` | The URL path scope of the cookie (e.g. "/"). |
| **`isSecure`** | `Boolean` | Whether the cookie is restricted to secure HTTPS connections. |
| **`isHttpOnly`** | `Boolean` | Whether the cookie is hidden from document.cookie JavaScript access. |
| **`hasExpires`** | `Boolean` | Whether the cookie specifies a fixed expiration date. |
| **`expires`** | `Date?` | The expiration timestamp, or null for session cookies. |

## Code Examples

### Compose Multiplatform (kotlin)

```kotlin
import org.daviante.kromium.api.cookie.KromiumCookie
import java.util.Date

val cookie = KromiumCookie(
    name = "session_id",
    value = "xyz123",
    domain = ".example.com",
    path = "/",
    isSecure = true,
    isHttpOnly = true,
    hasExpires = true,
    expires = Date(System.currentTimeMillis() + 86400000L)
)
```

### Pure Java (java)

```java
import org.daviante.kromium.api.cookie.KromiumCookie;
import java.util.Date;

public class CookieFactory {
    public static KromiumCookie createSessionCookie(String name, String value) {
        return new KromiumCookie(
            name,
            value,
            "example.com",
            "/",
            true,
            true,
            false,
            null
        );
    }
}
```


---

# KromiumCookieManager

```kotlin
interface KromiumCookieManager
```

- **Module:** `kromium-api`
- **Package:** `org.daviante.kromium.api.cookie`
- **Category:** Storage & Cookies
- **Since Version:** v1.0.0.150-b11

## Description

Interface for managing cookies across the browser engine. Provides suspending Kotlin coroutine and Java CompletableFuture APIs to query, set, delete, clear, and flush HTTP cookies to disk.

### When to Use

Obtain via engine.cookieManager to manipulate cookies globally across all browser sessions.

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`timeoutMs`** | `Long` | Timeout for cookie retrieval operations in milliseconds. |

## Methods

### `getCookies()`

```kotlin
suspend fun getCookies(url: String, includeHttpOnly: Boolean = true): Map<String, String>
```

Retrieves all cookies for the specified url as a key-value map.

- **Returns:** `Map<String, String>`

### `getCookiesAsync()`

```kotlin
fun getCookiesAsync(url: String, includeHttpOnly: Boolean = true): CompletableFuture<Map<String, String>>
```

Asynchronously retrieves all cookies for url returning a Java CompletableFuture.

- **Returns:** `CompletableFuture<Map<String, String>>`

### `getCookie()`

```kotlin
suspend fun getCookie(url: String, name: String): String?
```

Retrieves the value of a specific cookie by name for url.

- **Returns:** `String?`

### `getCookieAsync()`

```kotlin
fun getCookieAsync(url: String, name: String): CompletableFuture<String?>
```

Asynchronously retrieves a specific cookie by name for url returning a Java CompletableFuture.

- **Returns:** `CompletableFuture<String?>`

### `getAllCookies()`

```kotlin
suspend fun getAllCookies(): List<KromiumCookie>
```

Retrieves all cookies across all domains stored in the engine's global cookie store.

- **Returns:** `List<KromiumCookie>`

### `getAllCookiesAsync()`

```kotlin
fun getAllCookiesAsync(): CompletableFuture<List<KromiumCookie>>
```

Asynchronously retrieves all cookies across all domains stored in the global cookie store returning a Java CompletableFuture.

- **Returns:** `CompletableFuture<List<KromiumCookie>>`

### `setCookie()`

```kotlin
fun setCookie(url: String, name: String, value: String, domain: String? = null, path: String = "/", isSecure: Boolean = false, isHttpOnly: Boolean = false, expires: Date? = null): Boolean
```

Sets a cookie for the specified url.

- **Returns:** `Boolean`

### `deleteCookie()`

```kotlin
fun deleteCookie(url: String, name: String): Boolean
```

Deletes a specific cookie for the specified url.

- **Returns:** `Boolean`

### `clearCookies()`

```kotlin
fun clearCookies(): Boolean
```

Deletes all cookies from the cookie store.

- **Returns:** `Boolean`

### `flush()`

```kotlin
fun flush(): Boolean
```

Flushes the cookie store to disk to ensure session persistence.

- **Returns:** `Boolean`

## Code Examples

### Compose Multiplatform (kotlin)

```kotlin
import org.daviante.kromium.api.core.KromiumEngine

suspend fun manageCookies(engine: KromiumEngine) {
    val cookieManager = engine.cookieManager
    cookieManager.setCookie(
        url = "https://example.com",
        name = "auth_token",
        value = "secret-token-123",
        isSecure = true,
        isHttpOnly = true
    )
    val token = cookieManager.getCookie("https://example.com", "auth_token")
    cookieManager.flush()
}
```

### Pure Java (java)

```java
import org.daviante.kromium.api.core.KromiumEngine;
import org.daviante.kromium.api.cookie.KromiumCookieManager;

public class CookieHandler {
    public static void clearAll(KromiumEngine engine) {
        KromiumCookieManager cm = engine.getCookieManager();
        cm.clearCookies();
        cm.flush();
    }
}
```

# KromiumDownloadItem

```kotlin
data class KromiumDownloadItem(
    val id: Int,
    val url: String,
    val suggestedFileName: String,
    val totalBytes: Long,
    val receivedBytes: Long,
    val percentComplete: Int,
    val speed: Long,
    val isInProgress: Boolean,
    val isComplete: Boolean,
    val isCanceled: Boolean,
    val isPaused: Boolean = false,
    val fullPath: String = ""
)
```

- **Module:** `kromium-api`
- **Package:** `org.daviante.kromium.api.download`
- **Since Version:** v1.0.0.150-b11

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`id`** | `Int` | Unique identifier of the download. |
| **`url`** | `String` | Source URL of the download. |
| **`suggestedFileName`** | `String` | Suggested filename for the download item. |
| **`totalBytes`** | `Long` | Total size of the file in bytes, or -1 if unknown. |
| **`receivedBytes`** | `Long` | Number of bytes received so far. |
| **`percentComplete`** | `Int` | Download completion percentage (0-100), or -1 if indeterminate. |
| **`speed`** | `Long` | Estimated transfer speed in bytes per second. |
| **`isInProgress`** | `Boolean` | Whether the download is currently in progress. |
| **`isComplete`** | `Boolean` | Whether the download has finished successfully. |
| **`isCanceled`** | `Boolean` | Whether the download was canceled. |
| **`isPaused`** | `Boolean` | Whether the download is paused. |
| **`fullPath`** | `String` | Destination file path on disk. |

# KromiumCustomScheme

```kotlin
data class KromiumCustomScheme @JvmOverloads constructor(
    val schemeName: String,
    val isStandard: Boolean = true,
    val isLocal: Boolean = true,
    val isDisplayIsolated: Boolean = false,
    val isSecure: Boolean = true,
    val isCorsEnabled: Boolean = true,
    val isCspBypassing: Boolean = false,
    val isFetchEnabled: Boolean = true
)
```

- **Module:** `kromium-api`
- **Package:** `org.daviante.kromium.api.scheme`
- **Since Version:** v1.0.0.150-b11

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`schemeName`** | `String` | The name of the custom protocol scheme. |
| **`isStandard`** | `Boolean` | If true, treated as a standard scheme with authority/host component. |
| **`isLocal`** | `Boolean` | If true, treated as local, similar to file://. |
| **`isDisplayIsolated`** | `Boolean` | If true, can only be displayed from other origins with the same scheme. |
| **`isSecure`** | `Boolean` | If true, treated as secure (HTTPS-equivalent). |
| **`isCorsEnabled`** | `Boolean` | If true, CORS from/to this scheme are permitted. |
| **`isCspBypassing`** | `Boolean` | If true, CSP enforcements are bypassed. |
| **`isFetchEnabled`** | `Boolean` | If true, Fetch API is allowed for this scheme. |

```kotlin
data class KromiumAssetRequest @JvmOverloads constructor(

    val method: String = "GET",
    val scheme: String = "",
    val domain: String = "",
    val path: String = "/",
    val queryString: String? = null,

    val headers: Map<String, String> = emptyMap()
)
```

| **`headers`** | `Map<String, String>` | Request headers map. |


Sanitizes a requested URL path against directory traversal attempts. Returns null if path is malicious.

# KromiumException

```kotlin
sealed class KromiumException(@JvmField val errorCode: KromiumErrorCode, @JvmField val isRecoverable: Boolean, override val message: String, override val cause: Throwable? = null) : RuntimeException(message, cause)
```

- **Module:** `kromium-api`
- **Package:** `org.daviante.kromium.api.error`
- **Category:** Error Handling
- **Since Version:** v1.0.0.150-b11

## Description

Sealed exception hierarchy for all Kromium-specific errors. Provides an errorCode and isRecoverable flag for robust programmatic error handling and recovery.

### When to Use

Catch KromiumException or its typed subclasses when initializing the engine, configuring proxies, running JavaScript evaluations, exporting PDFs, or creating OSR browser canvases.

## States & Variants

| Variant | Declaration | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`KromiumException.NotInitialized`** | `class NotInitialized : KromiumException(KromiumErrorCode.INITIALIZATION_ERROR, false, "Kromium is not initialized. Call Kromium.initialize() first.")` | Kromium is not initialized. Call Kromium.initialize() first. |
| **`KromiumException.Disposed`** | `class Disposed : KromiumException(KromiumErrorCode.INITIALIZATION_ERROR, false, "Kromium has been disposed and cannot accept new operations.")` | Kromium has been disposed and cannot accept new operations. |
| **`KromiumException.UnsupportedPlatform`** | `class UnsupportedPlatform(@JvmField val os: String?, @JvmField val arch: String?) : KromiumException(KromiumErrorCode.UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM, false, ...)` | Unsupported platform: os=$os, arch=$arch |
| **`KromiumException.InstallationFailed`** | `class InstallationFailed(@JvmField val directory: String, cause: Throwable? = null) : KromiumException(KromiumErrorCode.INSTALLATION_FAILED, true, ...)` | Failed to prepare installation directory: $directory |
| **`KromiumException.AutoDownloadDisabled`** | `class AutoDownloadDisabled(@JvmField val directory: String) : KromiumException(KromiumErrorCode.DOWNLOAD_DISABLED, false, ...)` | Auto-download is disabled (autoDownload = false), and no valid JCEF engine binaries were found at: $directory |
| **`KromiumException.NoBundleAvailable`** | `class NoBundleAvailable(@JvmField val platform: String, @JvmField val releaseTag: String?) : KromiumException(KromiumErrorCode.NO_BUNDLE_AVAILABLE, false, ...)` | No compatible JCEF bundle found for $platform in release ${releaseTag ?: "latest"} |
| **`KromiumException.DownloadFailed`** | `class DownloadFailed(@JvmField val url: String, cause: Throwable? = null) : KromiumException(KromiumErrorCode.DOWNLOAD_FAILED, true, ...)` | Failed to download engine bundle from: $url |
| **`KromiumException.ChecksumMismatch`** | `class ChecksumMismatch(@JvmField val expected: String, @JvmField val actual: String) : KromiumException(KromiumErrorCode.CHECKSUM_MISMATCH, true, ...)` | Archive checksum mismatch — expected: $expected, actual: $actual. The download may be corrupted or tampered with. |
| **`KromiumException.ExtractionFailed`** | `class ExtractionFailed(@JvmField val archivePath: String, cause: Throwable? = null) : KromiumException(KromiumErrorCode.EXTRACTION_FAILED, true, ...)` | Failed to extract engine bundle from: $archivePath |
| **`KromiumException.MaliciousArchiveEntry`** | `class MaliciousArchiveEntry(@JvmField val entryName: String) : KromiumException(KromiumErrorCode.MALICIOUS_ARCHIVE, false, ...)` | Malicious archive entry detected (directory traversal): $entryName |
| **`KromiumException.BootstrapFailed`** | `class BootstrapFailed(cause: Throwable? = null) : KromiumException(KromiumErrorCode.BOOTSTRAP_FAILED, false, ...)` | CEF native bootstrap failed. |
| **`KromiumException.InstallationCorrupted`** | `class InstallationCorrupted(@JvmField val directory: String) : KromiumException(KromiumErrorCode.INSTALLATION_CORRUPTED, true, ...)` | JCEF installation at $directory appears corrupted — re-download required. |
| **`KromiumException.JsEvaluationTimeout`** | `class JsEvaluationTimeout(@JvmField val timeoutMs: Long) : KromiumException(KromiumErrorCode.JS_TIMEOUT, true, ...)` | JavaScript evaluation timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms |
| **`KromiumException.InvalidConfig`** | `class InvalidConfig(@JvmField val detail: String) : KromiumException(KromiumErrorCode.INVALID_CONFIG, false, ...)` | Invalid Kromium configuration: $detail |
| **`KromiumException.ProxyError`** | `class ProxyError(@JvmField val detail: String) : KromiumException(KromiumErrorCode.PROXY_ERROR, true, ...)` | Proxy error: $detail |
| **`KromiumException.PdfPrintFailed`** | `class PdfPrintFailed(@JvmField val path: String, cause: Throwable? = null) : KromiumException(KromiumErrorCode.PDF_PRINT_FAILED, true, ...)` | Failed to print web page to PDF: $path |
| **`KromiumException.FrameworkRequired`** | `class FrameworkRequired @JvmOverloads constructor(message: String = "UI framework is mandatory for OSR browser creation. No default OSR framework is permitted.") : KromiumException(KromiumErrorCode.FRAMEWORK_REQUIRED, false, message)` | UI framework is mandatory for OSR browser creation. No default OSR framework is permitted. |
| **`KromiumException.CanvasNotAvailable`** | `class CanvasNotAvailable @JvmOverloads constructor(@JvmField val framework: KromiumUiFramework, message: String = ...) : KromiumException(KromiumErrorCode.CANVAS_NOT_AVAILABLE, false, message)` | No OSR canvas factory registered for framework: $framework. Please ensure kromium-${framework.name.lowercase()} is on the classpath. |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`errorCode`** | `KromiumErrorCode` | Standardized error code classification for programmatic handling and telemetry. |
| **`isRecoverable`** | `Boolean` | Indicates whether the operation can be retried (true) or is a fatal state (false). |
| **`message`** | `String` | Human-readable diagnostic message explaining the cause of the failure. |
| **`cause`** | `Throwable?` | Underlying causal exception if wrapped. |

## Code Examples

### Compose Multiplatform (kotlin)

```kotlin
import org.daviante.kromium.api.error.KromiumException
import org.daviante.kromium.api.error.KromiumErrorCode

try {
    // engine operations
} catch (e: KromiumException) {
    if (e.isRecoverable) {
        println("Recoverable error [${e.errorCode}]: ${e.message}")
    } else {
        System.err.println("Fatal error [${e.errorCode}]: ${e.message}")
    }
}
```

### Pure Java (java)

```java
import org.daviante.kromium.api.error.KromiumException;

try {
    // engine operations
} catch (KromiumException e) {
    System.err.println("Error code: " + e.errorCode + ", recoverable: " + e.isRecoverable);
}
```
